title: Experiment Sketch
description: IDEATE-stage deep-ideation artifact. Output of the experiment-architect worker. A MINIMAL, runnable-next-quarter experiment design for ONE surviving idea — deliberately lighter than the DESIGN-stage experiment_matrix / protocol_spec (a sketch that makes an idea testable, NOT the full preregistered protocol). It enforces the report's 'designability gate': an idea that cannot be reduced to a minimal experiment with a concrete falsifier is not yet a real direction. Descriptive ONLY — no selection / bet / chosen / winner field (additionalProperties:false). Anti-slop: idea_ref is a real ref (contains a digit); every present string is non-blank (pattern \S). This artifact does NOT replace DESIGN: a bet idea still goes through full_rigor_minimal / design_experiment after /idea-bet.

sketch_id.description: Short unique identifier for this sketch, e.g. ES-001. Non-blank.

idea_ref.description: The idea_id this experiment tests (e.g. IDEA-1, EV-1). Real-ref guard: must contain a digit.

experiment.description: The minimal experiment to run — concrete enough that someone could start it next quarter. Non-blank.

controls.description: What is held fixed / the control condition(s) the comparison is against (e.g. 'same backbone, frozen vs adapted encoder'). At least one; each non-blank.

metrics.description: The observable metric(s) measured (e.g. 'Dice on the held-out canal set', 'boundary F1'). At least one; each non-blank.

observable_signals.description: What you would actually OBSERVE if the idea works vs fails (the read-out that distinguishes the two). At least one; each non-blank.

falsifier.description: The concrete result that would FALSIFY the idea (e.g. 'no Dice gain over the frozen-encoder baseline at matched compute'). Non-blank — an idea with no falsifier is not yet testable.

discriminating_evidence.description: Optional (2026-08-07). Which TWO competing mechanisms this design tells apart, and the observation that separates them — the difference between a decisive experiment and a demonstration. For a genuinely single-mechanism idea it instead states what a failure would point to. 'The metric goes up' is not discriminating evidence; it names no mechanism.

next_branch.description: Optional: what to try next if this experiment fails (the recovery branch).

feasibility.description: Optional feasibility triple, mirroring idea_backlog (the single biggest cost should dominate the rating).

notes.description: Optional caveats (e.g. assumptions the sketch depends on, north-star drift).
